summary: E90: context_ranking — memory.get_history() returns unbounded NDJSON fact entries (schema: event_id/key/value/status/actor/timestamp). These are injected into LLM context via helen.py:53-57 concatenated with the system message. adapters.py:21-26 extracts h.get('metadata',{}).get('role') and h.get('content','') from each history item. Memory fact entries have neither 'metadata' nor 'content' keys, so ALL history items resolve to role='user', content='' — empty user messages. History occupies context slots but carries zero semantic content. Secondary: memory.py:75 uses datetime.utcnow() — mu_DETERMINISM violation per CLAUDE.md.
hypothesis: If memory.get_history() returns structurally incompatible entries (no 'metadata'/'content' keys), then all injected history becomes empty user messages, wasting context tokens and providing zero conversational continuity to the LLM.
